about: Copy to dev-hosts.local.json (never committed) and list your own servers there; bun run build:extension then stages dist/extension-dev/, which signs in to them and takes journeys from them. This machine's stand-ins (localhost, app.localhost, api.localhost) are built in, so this example lists none. A server is three https origins: { "api": "https://api.example.com", "app": "https://app.example.com", "site": "https://example.com" }.
